integrity: Theorem and all normalizations reproduced in RESULT.md. Numerical tests are finite corroboration, not proofs of the asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: Exactly symmetric all-to-all three-way mutation on the critical interaction line; strictly positive initial species populations; no stochastic, spatial, or phase-locking claim. Existing classical unmutated cycles and constant-mutation equilibria are acknowledged; publication priority beyond the inspected sources is not independently established.
title: A cumulative-mutation threshold for critical three-species competition
